title: post pages login php authenticate user
description: Test user authentication by sending POST requests to /pages/login.php with valid and invalid credentials. Verify correct session cookie issuance on success and appropriate error messages on failure.

title: post pages signup php register new user
description: Test user registration by sending POST requests to /pages/signup.php with new and existing email addresses. Verify 201 Created response with user_id and session cookie for new users and 409 Conflict error for duplicate emails.

title: get api products get products php fetch products
description: Test product fetching by sending GET requests to /api/products/get_products.php with various query parameters like page, limit, category, and sort. Verify correct paginated product lists, filtering, sorting, and proper error handling for invalid parameters.

title: post api cart add php add product to cart
description: Test adding products to cart by sending POST requests to /api/cart/add.php with product_id and quantity, including cases for in-stock and out-of-stock products. Verify updated cart summary on success and 409 Conflict error for out-of-stock.

title: post api checkout process php process order
description: Test order processing by sending POST requests to /api/checkout/process.php with payment_method, shipping_address, and optional coupon_code. Verify 201 Created response with order_id and status 'pending', and validate error handling for missing required fields.

title: get admin products php admin product management
description: Test admin product management access by sending GET requests to /admin/products.php with and without valid admin session cookies. Verify 200 OK with product management UI for authorized admins and 302 Redirect or 401 Unauthorized for unauthorized access.

title: get admin orders php admin order management
description: Test admin order management access by sending GET requests to /admin/orders.php with valid admin session cookies. Verify 200 OK response with order management UI.
